liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I'm A King Bee** (2 reviews): Described as a nasty performance of the song; Bill Kreutzmann's frenetic polyrhythms propel the band while Garcia and Lesh circle [13][17]
- **Hard To Handle** (2 reviews): Cited as the best version of the song the reviewer has heard; Best version ever, with incredible build-up taking the jam over the top [18][22]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Rhythms intensify until resembling a crashing locomotive, with Bill Kreutzmann shining [11]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Considered the sharpest version of the song ever recorded [15]

## The recordings

- **gd71-04-28.sbd.murphy.2248.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 42 songs; 270 min; rated 4.88/5 by 25 [1]. Said about its sound: Slight popping occurs during the new rider set, otherwise stellar performance; The mix is described as almost perfect with unique energy [13][18]
- **gd1971-04-28.sbd.kaplan-fink.11257.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 204 min [9]
- **gd1971-04-28.sbd.unknown.4332.shnf**: soundboard; 42 songs; 270 min [2]
- **gd1971-04-28.sbd.miller.106099.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 280 min; rated 4.88/5 by 17 [3]

## Around the show

- New Riders set opened the show, providing the full feel [20]
- Tom Constanten appears on stage from Dark Star through Not Fade Away [10]
- Reviewers call this their personal favorite, more trippy than the April 29th show [11]
- Identified as the best night of the Fillmore East run [16]
- Described as epic and better than the Live/Dead album version [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-04-28.sbd.murphy.2248.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Bob Murphy; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Second half and Wharf Rat lost in a reel-to-reel tape flip; Missing section released on the four-disc Ladies and Gentlemen set; Transferred from MSR tape via Alesis Masterlink to CD-R by Bob Murphy [1][15][19]
- **gd1971-04-28.sbd.kaplan-fink.11257.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan and Alan Fink; source: Truckin'through Bird Song 02:07.38: MSR>Reel>Alesis Masterlink>CDR Bird Song 02:08.70 through end of show: MSR 7 inch(7.5 ips)Revox A 77>Alesis Masterlink>CDR… [9]. Also: Cuts at five minutes due to probable reel flip, cross-faded from source [9]
- **gd1971-04-28.sbd.unknown.4332.shnf**: transferred by Unknown; source: Workin' Man Blues through the cut in Bird Song: MR>R>CDR the cut in Bird Song through the end: MR>CDR [2]
- **gd1971-04-28.sbd.miller.106099.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Shure Line Mixers -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Master Reel (Sony Deck - BASF Tapes - 1/4 Track - 7 1/2 ips) [3]
